name: Bgt-V2
description: A Telegram music player bot, written in Python with Pyrogram and py-tgcalls.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Put your bot token from BotFather

MONGO_DB_URI.description: Get a MongoDB URL from https://cloud.mongodb.com

MUSIC_BOT_NAME.description: A name for your Music Bot. You can use special characters

OWNER_ID.description: User id(s) of the owner(s). Separate multiple values with a space.

STRING_SESSION.description: A Pyrogram v2 String Session. One assistant is compulsory.

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Your log group ID. Add your bot and promote it as admin with full rights!

CHANNE_USERNAME.description: Your channel username without @. Add your bot and promote it as admin!

CHANNEL_ID.description: Your channel ID. Add your bot and promote it as admin with full rights!
